The parameters that can be tuned in COCA are the ``maxK`` number of possible clusters, the clustering methods used, the types of distances to be computed for each omic matrix and whether or not the Dunn index should be used for determining the optimal number of clusters. Technically, none of these is a tunable hyperparameter, however. Here, we stick to hierarchical clustering with appropriate distances for every modality (binary distance for SNPs, Euclidean distance for continuous modalities) and set ``maxK = 10``. We do not use the Dunn index for determining the optimal number of clusters (as per default). 

We, therefore, run the core function ``buildMOC()`` once and use the resulting distance matrix for spectral clustering and the optimal number of clusters is determined...
